gimbal_tracker_ros2.role: C++17 pan/tilt simulator. This orchestrator can run its step-response and estimator Monte Carlo binaries when they are already built. It does not invoke the lead demo.

stm32_motor_safety_fw.role: STM32F4 pan/tilt positioner firmware. Host ctest and Renode are optional. The lightweight campaign and the UART adapter follow the documented shell, soft limits, and keep-out rules.
